notes.title: UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ Voice Drama Update
notes.content:
There was an issue where users were not able to access the Simplified Chinese video files after downloading the UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ Voice Drama. This issue has been addressed and those files should now be downloadable if the user's language setting is set to Simplified Chinese.

If you wish to download those video files when not using Simplified Chinese language settings, right click on the UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ Voice Drama in your Steam Library and select Properties. The general tab will have an option to change languages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44431254/b787de74d0d7423cd390d06861dc7b9b587f411a.jpg[/img]

An update will be coming with liner notes including a translation for the cast commentary track. Thank you for your understanding and please enjoy this continuation to the UsoNatsu story!

notes.title: 1.05 Update
notes.content:
An update has been pushed out with a number of fixes.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Skip speed can now be adjusted
[*]Framerate can now be adjusted
[*]Improved character sprite transitions in a particular scene
[*]Improved lip sync
[*]Chapter-related achievements automatically are received when said chapter is cleared
[/list]

notes.title: 1.04 Update
notes.content: An update was pushed out which addresses an issue where the FPS may exceed 60 and cause the CPU and/or GPU to be over-utilized. The update caps framerate at 60 FPS to prevent this issue.

notes.title: UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ Releasing on Oct. 24th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44431254/e525026d1497a497822008ec2c8853717f689ba2.jpg[/img]

Here's some interesting stats for you

Thank you to everyone who is looking forward to the release & who downloaded and tried the demo!
